motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable CSS transitions/animations, smooth scrolling and the follower; retain 80ms opacity feedback for the mobile menu and assistant.

motion.name: cursor-pointer-gate
motion.purpose: Enable the supplementary cursor only for a fine pointer while motion is allowed.

motion.name: mobile-menu-enter
motion.purpose: Reveal the mobile panel with a vertical clip; the trigger morphs into a close glyph.

motion.name: mobile-menu-exit
motion.purpose: Close the mobile panel more quickly than it enters.

motion.name: mobile-menu-stagger
motion.purpose: Sibling link delay, bounded by six navigation items; omitted for reduced motion.

motion.name: assistant-enter
motion.purpose: Body-portal panel opacity and 20px translation after a 70ms first-arrival pause; visible interruptions continue from the current frame without replaying the pause.

motion.name: assistant-exit
motion.purpose: Panel opacity and 8px translation without delay; commit the final frame before cancellation and removal, then return focus.

motion.name: overlay-reduced-feedback
motion.purpose: Opacity-only menu and assistant feedback without panel translation, clip movement or stagger.

motion.name: assistant-arrival-pause
motion.purpose: First-arrival settling pause only; preserved through development effect replay and omitted for reduced motion.

motion.name: link-color-feedback
motion.purpose: Hyperlink color and quiet surface response in both directions.

motion.name: link-underline-feedback
motion.purpose: Emerald text-action underline reveal and retraction; inline article links use 0.34s and retain their resting underline.

motion.name: project-disclosure
motion.purpose: Case-study grid disclosure with 0.26s opacity feedback; collapsed content remains inert, and reduced motion uses opacity only.

motion.name: route-arrival
motion.purpose: Public route opacity settle from 0.9 to 1; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: traffic-point-feedback
motion.purpose: Point dot background and transform feedback; reduced motion removes both transition and transform. Chart values and layout coordinates do not animate.

narrative.overview:
A precise technical sheet gives infrastructure work a calm, inspectable setting. Graphite surfaces, warm cream text, parchment and fine calibrated rules carry the terminal and grid influence. Emerald marks action and state; sparse sand detail adds warmth to technical metadata and connector geometry. Dense evidence sits within generous reading margins; typography and alignment establish the hierarchy.

The visual identity supports Linux, Cloud and Security through readable sans-serif content and restrained technical detail. Dark and light modes share the same geometry; project specimens follow the active neutral surfaces, text and rules. The owner selected Graphite + Emerald + Parchment while preserving the latest public and dashboard layouts. The real portrait remains an identity asset within this system.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral graphite and warm parchment with emerald signals and sparse sand detail.
Fine linework and flat, clearly separated surfaces.
Catamaran display, Public Sans reading, JetBrains Mono technical detail.
Square and lightly softened controls with visible keyboard focus.
Restrained motion, persistent themes and a supplementary cursor follower.

rules.name: The Paired Themes Rule
rules.body: Use the active canvas, text, muted, panel, signal, warm and line roles together, including within project specimens and dashboard panels; keep fixed code roles paired on their own canvas.

rules.name: The Reading Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep main content and controls in Public Sans; use JetBrains Mono for code, tags, technical metadata and footer details.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate ordinary content with proximity, space and surface tone; use fine rules for meaningful boundaries and reserve soft shadows for utility overlays, revealed workflow detail and cursor response.

dos: **Do** use paired theme roles for public and dashboard surfaces, including neutral project specimens; retain the fixed paired code canvas.
**Do** keep reading content in Public Sans and reserve JetBrains Mono for code, tags, technical metadata and footer details.
**Do** build hierarchy with type, proximity, margins and tonal fields; keep rules for meaningful boundaries.
**Do** preserve visible keyboard focus, thin single-border field focus, readable light and dark states, and the reduced-motion and pointer accommodations.
**Do** use inline line icons or the established custom file/checklist geometry for technical illustrations.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce fixed emerald specimen fields or the dashboard's superseded gray/lime literals in place of shared roles.
**Don't** make the homepage's split composition or section rail a requirement for other surfaces.
**Don't** turn static tags into controls or make the custom cursor the only sign that an element is interactive.
**Don't** replace readable sans-serif prose with terminal-style monospace text.
